purpose: Teach: 伐採/急性/海峡/激怒/不条理/醸造/戦艦/着工

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、不法伐採の現場を警察、押さえました
lines.en: We've secured the site of the illegal logging operation.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, official but not cold. Steady pace. Ground the statement with the weight of procedure completed. Small pause before the close.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、急性中毒の事件を捜査しております
lines.en: We're currently investigating the acute poisoning case.
lines.style: Measured, procedural tone. Even cadence. Professional distance maintained. This is report, not emotion. Slight emphasis on 'currently' to signal ongoing work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、海峡上の不審船を警察、追跡されたんですね
lines.en: So we tracked down that suspicious vessel in the strait, then?
lines.style: Quiet wonder underneath. Processing aloud, checking his understanding. Slightly deferential — speaking to an authority. Gentle curiosity, not challenge.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者ご家族の激怒に丁寧に対応します
lines.en: We're handling the victim's family's anger with all the care we can.
lines.style: Steady and grave. Acknowledge the emotional weight without flinching. Slower pace — this is delicate ground. Quiet conviction on 'care'.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、不条理な事件に警察、向き合っておられますね
lines.en: The police are really confronting some senseless situations, aren't they?
lines.style: Soft observation, almost to himself. Respectful acknowledgment of burden. Trailing rise on the question — inviting the officer to agree, not demanding. Slight tilt of admiration.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不法な醸造業者を摘発しました
lines.en: We've shut down the illegal brewing operation.
lines.style: Clipped, efficient. Action completed. Professional satisfaction without boasting. Crisp attack on the opening word. Brief and settled.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、戦艦遺物の盗難を警察、調査中ですね
lines.en: There was a theft of warship artifacts you're looking into, right?
lines.style: Careful phrasing — he's checking his facts. Deferential but engaged. Pace slightly uncertain, like he's making sure he has it right. Genuine interest underneath.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不法着工の工事を停止させました
lines.en: We've halted the illegal construction work.
lines.style: Direct and final. No elaboration needed. Firm but not harsh. The close of one task. Even breath, solid ground beneath each word.
